desc: Classify indices into D (1->0), U (0->1), E (1->1), ignored (0->0).
Establish ordering: all removals (D ∪ X) before all additions (U ∪ X); removals by descending C, additions by ascending C; optimal X is a prefix of E sorted by descending C.
Derive cost formula: costR + costS + M * sum_{E\X} C, with M=|R|+|S|.
Implement Fenwick-tree incremental prefix evaluation: insert D into R and U into S using the derived deltas, then process E descending C, updating costR/costS/M/Esum and tracking the minimum total.
Brute-force validation via Dijkstra over bitmask states on random small-N cases (tie handling, mixed parities) plus all 3 public samples -- all passed.
